status: Exploratory follow-up defined after the primary EN-TEx results, before these follow-up scores

rna.label: Supplied imbalance_significance for each informative SNV/experiment
rna.interpretation: Locus representation predicting RNA allelic imbalance; not haplotype direction or donor-specific sequence prediction
rna.folds_seeds_contexts: Unchanged manuscript 5 folds x 3 seeds x strict/1hop
rna.encoders: Frozen canonical PangenomeFM and original NT cache; no biological fine-tuning

prediction_followups.equal_locus_weight: Each test measurement has weight 1 / number of test measurements at its locus within the assay and run; labels remain per measurement
prediction_followups.eligibility: Every fold must meet count thresholds; eligibility based only on labels/counts, shared across seeds, contexts and feature sets
prediction_followups.macro: Equal weight over the same eligible tissues (or donors) within each fold/seed; then paired hierarchical fold/seed bootstrap
prediction_followups.normalized_ap: (AP - weighted positive prevalence) / (1 - weighted positive prevalence)
prediction_followups.limitations: Pointwise exploratory intervals; overlapping training folds and multiple analyses. Donor/tissue stratification is not donor/tissue-held-out fitting. Reweighting changes evaluation, not the original training objective.
